summary: A field that opens a Calendar in a popover: picking a day, or a range's last day, closes it and writes the date into the field.

props.name: label
props.description: The name above the field, wired to it as its label.

props.name: description
props.example: Your files back up at 2:00 that night.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What the field says before anything is picked.

props.name: mode
props.description: Picks one day, or a range from its first day to its last.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The picked day or range on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked day or range, controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.typeName: (value: Date | DateRange | undefined, day?: Date) => void
props.description: Called with the new day or range whenever it changes, and the day that was clicked.

props.name: disabledDays
props.description: Days that cannot be picked: a date, a list of them, a range, or a function of the date.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The first day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.

props.name: clearable
props.description: An X in the field that empties it, shown once something is picked.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a form under this name: `2026-11-18`, or a range as `2026-11-09/2026-11-13`.

props.name: size
props.description: The field's height, width and text.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the field, the popup and its day keys. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks opening and dims the whole control, label included.

props.name: animated
props.description: The popup's scale-in and the calendar's moving key. Turn it off for both to jump; reduced motion does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.

props.label: Next backup
props.description: Your files back up at 2:00 that night.
